purpose: Teach: 持ち込む/値引き/コツコツ/売店/上層/掛かり/精算/夜勤

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様、本気で、絶対、新案、絶対、持ち込む、絶対、ご提案、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: We should absolutely present a new proposal to our key clients with full confidence.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful opening. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. Steady pace, forward momentum. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、値引き、絶対、戦略、絶対、見直しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're genuinely committed to reviewing our discount strategy to serve them better.
lines.style: Attentive, eager to show alignment. Slight nod in the voice. Warm but professional—a junior affirming direction from someone he respects.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人社員、本気で、絶対、コツコツ、絶対、頑張ってますね
lines.en: The new hires are really putting in the effort, day after day. You can see it.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, almost proud. Soft warmth in the middle of the sentence. Not exaggerated praise—the observation of someone who notices quiet work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、本気で、絶対、売店、絶対、社員、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The in-store kiosk has been getting really positive feedback from the team. We're grateful for that.
lines.style: Straightforward, informative. A small lift of pride in the middle. The tone of sharing good news without overselling it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、上層、絶対、部、絶対、報告、絶対、まとめましょう
lines.en: Let's compile a report for upper management about all of this. We should bring them in.
lines.style: Decisive but collaborative. 'Compile' lands with quiet authority. Slight pause before the final phrase, inviting agreement. Clear about the next step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、各、絶対、掛かり、絶対、ご相談ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful we could consult with each department head. It made a real difference.
lines.style: Warm sincerity underneath the professional surface. Unhurried. The gratitude is genuine, not performed. A slight breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、精算、絶対、システム、絶対、改良しましょう
lines.en: Let's improve the customer checkout system. That's something we should prioritize.
lines.style: Purposeful, calm authority. Emphasis on 'improve' without hardness. Forward-looking without impatience. The voice of someone thinking about what matters most.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、夜勤、絶対、手当、絶対、引き上げております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've actually been raising the night-shift allowance for staff. We wanted to get that right.
lines.style: Earnest satisfaction. Small emphasis on 'raising'—a moment of quiet pride in doing the right thing. Warm close. Not rushed.
